behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert exactly one injected normalization for valid and invalid results and error identity.
Assert legacy wrapper/default outputs and normalized core does not transform strings again.
docDelivery: Explain normalized core versus legacy raw wrappers and single pipeline call.
Document ASCII lowercasing, validation priority, display behavior and injection errors.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: String name pipeline, explicit normalize-once injection and unchanged raw wrappers/core validation priority.
manualBehavior: Verify one normalization result flows to shared normalized validation/display core; no duplicate rules or hidden second normalization in pipeline/core. Legacy raw wrappers must use that same core.
independence: Remove repeated normalization across a validation pipeline while preserving public outputs and explicit normalization call counts.
